away.summary: The Sabres are coming off a 3-2 overtime loss to the Blackhawks. They are projected to have a relatively healthy lineup with the exception of several injured players. Notably, defenseman Miro Heiskanen will miss his fourth straight game due to an upper body injury, while forward Matt Duchene is also out with a lower body injury. The team is looking to bounce back after a tough loss.

doubtful.detail: Heiskanen took part in the Stars morning skate but the defenseman will miss his fourth straight game; he is also doubtful to play against the Florida Panthers on Sunday.

home.summary: The Stars are coming off a 4-3 win over the San Jose Sharks. They are projected to have a strong lineup with the exception of several injured players. Notably, defenseman Miro Heiskanen will miss his fourth straight game due to an upper body injury, while forward Matt Duchene is also out with a lower body injury. The team is looking to build on their recent success.
